releaseNotes:
## Conference families and groups
- Group existing participants as a family, rename the group, change its members, or ungroup it.
- Keep each person's room, travel details, meals, and historical booking records independent.
- Apply selected travel details to selected family members.
- Link a family to an existing household, or review and create a household from its participants.
- See compact family counts and split-room details in Weekly.

## Guest Inbox
- Reading and replying now use Back to return to the previous inbox or folder view.
- Removed the Next needs reply shortcut.

## Monthly overview
- Conference day-guest counts include unnamed adults and children, using the highest combined meal count each day instead of adding meals together.
- Print a clean guest-room overview on one A4 landscape sheet, with the existing booking colours and a matching legend.
- Staff rooms, meeting rooms, controls, and operational extras are left out of the printed overview.

## Update reliability
- Source downloads are packaged from the release tag, excluding local temporary files, secrets, databases, backups, and build artifacts.
- Only an installer matching the release version can be attached.
